description: We build your design project turnkey in Kyiv: renovation from $550/m², materials, furniture and decor, supervision. Estimate within ±5% when CAS renovates.
h1: Turnkey implementation of your design project
price: renovation from $550 / m² · furnishing from $250 / m²
lead: You already have a design project — by us or by another designer. We implement it in full: check the drawings, calculate the estimate, renovate, and purchase materials, furniture and lighting. You get the interior from the visualisations, not something “roughly similar”.
cards: measurement and check against the site

about: One contractor instead of a dozen

A design project most often “breaks” during renovation: the crew simplifies details, the supplier swaps items and the furniture does not fit the niches. We take on implementation turnkey — from rough works to arranged furniture and hung curtains — and are responsible for the result as one team.

We work with other designers’ projects: if you wish, we agree solutions with the author, and if author supervision is not ordered, our architect makes sure every detail matches the drawings. Any changes are agreed with you in writing before they are made.
steps: We check drawings, specifications and the site.
Works, materials, furniture — by item and date.
Rough works, engineering and finishing to the drawings.
Materials, furniture, lighting and decor to the specification.
faq: Do you implement projects by other designers?
Yes. First we audit the drawings and specifications, add the missing details and calculate the estimate.
Renovation from $550 per m², offices from $350 per m², furnishing from $250 per m². If CAS does the renovation, the total stays within ±5% of the estimate.
